name: 04-homepage-contrast-avatars
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished full-page desktop website screenshot in long portrait format, approximately 1024x2560 to 1024x3000. No browser or device chrome. Reference image 1 is approved visual direction for ExFu. Preserve its bold grotesk typography, layered matte paper planes and red numerals, ExFu wordmark (white geometric Ex over a small black square, loose red handwritten Fu), warm humanity and spacious hierarchy. This request is a design image, not code. User wants SOME background contrast restored but no harsh zebra black-white or full red walls. Palette: pale stone #F1F0EC, warm putty #D7CEC2, deep mushroom #514B45, charcoal text #252421, brand red #BC3D2B. White-ish text only on the single deep mushroom section. Use ~65% pale stone, ~25% mid-tone putty and ~10% deep mushroom; no jet black whole sections. Rich readable paragraphs: not tiny grey filler. Whitespace BETWEEN meaningful groups, paragraphs 55-70 characters wide. Bold headings, calm text. No fake results or client testimonials, no lorem ipsum, no code visible, no SEO keyword block, no overly repetitive card grid. Full coherent page with nav, footer. Navigation "Work together" "Recent work" "About" "Get in touch". Footer "ExFu" "CV & experience" "Open-source tools" "Contact" "WhaleyBear Ltd".
HOMEPAGE REVISION of reference image 1. Preserve opening "Fractional AI support & delivery" / "You see the potential. Let’s make it work." and paragraph "Work out where AI can make a difference in your business. Get the backing to make the case, build it, and bring your team with you." Button "Find your starting point"; link "Have a brief? Let’s talk."; line "Remote engagements. Bristol in person by arrangement."
Keep sculptural 1/2/3 papers on right hero, subtly simplified and smaller. REMOVE the duplicated three-stage process section immediately below hero, use that room for substantive offer section:
"Fractional support for the person moving AI forward."
"ExFu is Alastair Brayne’s AI consultancy. I work alongside founders, CTOs, and internal advocates to assess opportunities, make the case to leadership, and deliver agents and workflows your team can own."
"That can include customer research, shared context, integrations, internal tools, or a customer-facing agent. We choose the work around a business goal."
Button "Explore fractional support".
A modest warm putty inset on right of this section says "Ongoing support" / "Defined projects" / "Remote collaboration". Not a dashboard.
THEN put a distinct MID-TONE PUTTY full-width recognition section: "Different people. Familiar sticking points." Left text "You may be leading the change, building it, or trying to get on top of your own work." Right fan of FOUR charcoal-illustrated portrait cards, use reference portraits faithfully as source assets: CTO man glasses; CEO woman grey hair; business owner Black man; coach Black woman. Slight rotations -9,-3,+3,+9 degrees, faces visible, cream paper, thin red details, no black playing-card backgrounds. Caption "Leading a business" "Backing a team" "Managing your own work" as readable need labels below fan, not all four card faces smothered in text. Small clarification "Illustrated examples" at bottom. No fake quotes, no testimonials. Link "Explore ways to work together". Fan is below hero and main fractional offer, ~middle page. Keep a static accessible feel, subtle design hint that cards can be explored.
Then short pale area "Recent work" / "Travel: testing a channel, then building on site." / "EV mapping: helping an internal specialist take ownership." links "Read the project". Then compact "Alastair Brayne" / "20+ years in software. AI founder. Trained psychotherapist."
THEN one dark MUSHROOM #514B45 section, restrained and beautiful with ample breathing room: huge ExFu wordmark left, cream Ex and red-orange Fu with readable contrast, three definitions right in off-white text: "Execution fu" / "The art of making AI work for you."; "Executive function" / "Support for planning and following through."; "Executive, functioning" / "More headspace for the person everyone turns to." The section adds warmth and rhythm, not aggressive black. No numbering here.
Final pale quiz band "What would you like help with?" options "AI across my business" / "A specific project" / "My own workload", red button "Find your starting point", small "A few questions, then an invitation to talk."
This revision must visibly have more contextual prose and measured background contrast than the supplied image while still readable at a glance. Make a stunning convincing website design.

name: 05-fractional-service
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished full-page desktop website screenshot in long portrait format, approximately 1024x2560 to 1024x3000. No browser or device chrome. Reference image 1 is approved visual direction for ExFu. Preserve its bold grotesk typography, layered matte paper planes and red numerals, ExFu wordmark (white geometric Ex over a small black square, loose red handwritten Fu), warm humanity and spacious hierarchy. This request is a design image, not code. User wants SOME background contrast restored but no harsh zebra black-white or full red walls. Palette: pale stone #F1F0EC, warm putty #D7CEC2, deep mushroom #514B45, charcoal text #252421, brand red #BC3D2B. White-ish text only on the single deep mushroom section. Use ~65% pale stone, ~25% mid-tone putty and ~10% deep mushroom; no jet black whole sections. Rich readable paragraphs: not tiny grey filler. Whitespace BETWEEN meaningful groups, paragraphs 55-70 characters wide. Bold headings, calm text. No fake results or client testimonials, no lorem ipsum, no code visible, no SEO keyword block, no overly repetitive card grid. Full coherent page with nav, footer. Navigation "Work together" "Recent work" "About" "Get in touch". Footer "ExFu" "CV & experience" "Open-source tools" "Contact" "WhaleyBear Ltd".
NEW INTERIOR PAGE: fractional AI support service. Use ONLY first reference for visual language; do not repeat homepage composition or giant paper hero. This page demonstrates a content-rich website with excellent reading design. Large page title, SMALL restrained layered folded-paper red accent to upper right, local section navigation in a quiet left rail, readable flowing editorial body on right. All important details visible, not all collapsed. NO oversized repeated marketing hero, no card grid. Put the two richer prose sections near the middle in a beautifully set reading column. Approx 450 words of substantive readable text. Include one FAQ open, remaining two closed rows at bottom.
Header breadcrumb "Work together / Fractional AI support".
Opening on warm putty #D7CEC2:
Heading "Move AI forward with experienced help alongside you."
Lead "You have opportunities to explore and a business to keep running. Get ongoing help deciding what is worth doing, making the case, and getting it built."
CTA "Discuss fractional support", secondary "Find your starting point".
Small factual line "Alastair Brayne · Remote engagements · Bristol by arrangement".
Below hero quick summary across pale background, not chunky cards: "Work alongside your CTO" / "Strategy and hands-on delivery" / "Build internal ownership".
Body left rail "On this page" with links "When it helps" "What we work on" "How we work" "Recent experience" "Practical questions"; active link red. Main readable column right, 55-70char line width, significant 24px-ish text at 1024 resolution:
H2 "When you need more than enthusiasm."
Paragraph "You may already have a CTO or someone pushing AI forward. They need time, technical backing, and a proposal leadership can assess. Fractional support adds experience alongside them as the work develops."
Paragraph "We start with a business goal and the assumptions behind it. That might mean exploring a new customer channel, improving access to business knowledge, or building a workflow nobody currently has capacity to run."
H2 "What we can work on."
Paragraph "The work can include opportunity assessment, small experiments, leadership proposals, agents, integrations, shared context, and internal tools. Your needs determine the mix of advice, engineering, and team support."
Paragraph "Ownership matters from the outset. We involve the people who will use the work and help an internal specialist or team maintain and extend it."
A small unboxed link "Read about agents, context, and integrations".
Then full-width deep MUSHROOM #514B45 (single dark warm section), generous cream type:
Heading "A first project gives the work somewhere to start."
Three sequence headings in one spacious row "Choose a goal" / "Test the assumptions" / "Build with your team".
Supporting line "Agree the scope and working rhythm together. Review what the evidence tells us before deciding the next step."
Return pale stone:
H2 "Recent experience"
A big editorial case excerpt without invented imagery:
"Travel"
"A prototype tested a possible customer-discovery channel. The findings redirected investment into an agent on the company’s own website, with the development team trained to take ownership."
Link "Read the project"
Small adjacent text "EV mapping" / "Experiments across management teams and training for an in-house AI specialist." 
H2 "Practical questions"
One OPEN FAQ with visible detailed answer:
"Can you work alongside our CTO?"
"Yes. Support can sit alongside your existing technical leadership. We agree who makes decisions, who does the work, and who owns it internally."
Two CLOSED rows: "Can we start with a defined project?" / "How are scope and fees agreed?"
Bottom quiet mid-tone PUTTY call to action:
"Tell me what you are trying to move forward."
"A short brief is enough to start a conversation."
Button "Discuss fractional support"; link "Or find your starting point".
Footer.
Maintain the warmth and boldness of the approved homepage, but this must unmistakably be a detailed service offering page with substantial body prose, readable typography and intentional reading navigation. No unsupported revenue gains, prices, exact available days, fabricated testimonials or guarantees. Do not label anything 'for agents' or SEO.
